The `todo.py` file defines a `TodoStore` class that manages a list of todo items. The state of the todos is stored in an instance variable called `self.todos`, which is a list. Each todo item is a dictionary with two keys: `"task"` (the text of the todo) and `"done"` (a boolean indicating whether the todo is completed). 

When a todo is added using `add_todo`, it is appended to the list as a new dictionary. The `complete_todo` method marks a todo as done by setting the `"done"` key to `True` for the todo at the specified index. The state of all todos is preserved in the `self.todos` list, which persists as long as the `TodoStore` instance exists.
